D: A hotshot lawyer is ordered to coach a team of misfit kids in peewee ice hockey.
P: Serve the snacks when the Ducks pull off the Flying V for the first time.
S: Cubes of firm mozzarella dipped in light batter and fried golden, with ranch for dipping.
Wild rice simmered with chicken, carrot, celery and onion in a creamy stock, ladled into small cups.
Two thin beef patties sealed around a slice of cheese, griddled so the cheese melts inside, in slider buns with pickles.
M: Beef mince browned with onion, mixed with corn, green beans and a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with potato gems and baked at 200C for 35 minutes.
Spaghetti and beef meatballs simmered in tomato sauce with garlic and basil, served in a big pot with grated parmesan.
W: Chocolate brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, topped with white chocolate icing smoothed like ice, cut into squares.
K: Dark chocolate melted into hot milk, whisked frothy, topped with marshmallows in big mugs.

s.how: Cut 400g firm mozzarella into 2cm cubes. Whisk 1 cup self-raising flour with 250ml cold milk and a pinch of salt. Dip the cubes in the batter and fry in 5cm hot oil for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. Serve with ranch dressing.

Divide 700g beef mince into 16 thin patties. Sandwich half a slice of American cheese between 2 patties and pinch the edges sealed, making 8. Griddle 4 minutes a side, rest 2 minutes so the cheese doesn't burst, and serve in 8 slider buns with pickles.

m.how: Brown 600g beef mince with an onion and 200g mushrooms. Stir in 200g corn, 200g chopped green beans and 250ml cream. Tip into a dish, cover with 500g potato gems and bake at 200C for 35 minutes.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs and fold in 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Spread 150g melted white chocolate smooth over the top like ice and cut into squares.

d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until frothy. Pour into big mugs and pile marshmallows on top. Ducks fly together.
